note: These are planned next-build checks. Do not count them as executed by Astra or use unit mocks to claim browser persistence/hardware behavior. Existing 26 independent tests are separately recorded.

cases.title: First valid completion
cases.setup: New career, 0 credits, no chapter flag
cases.action: Complete one valid Harbor attempt through normal race rules
cases.expected: 800 credits total; one durable receipt and first-completion flag; no separate 100-credit payout
cases.evidence: Attempt UUID, validity result, before/after durable record and UI

cases.title: Repeated result delivery
cases.setup: The first attempt has been rewarded
cases.action: Redeliver its result, reopen results, reload and revisit receipt
cases.expected: Balance remains 800; one receipt; first chapter does not repeat
cases.evidence: Same UUID across calls; ledger and visible result state

cases.title: Valid replay
cases.setup: First reward claimed and kit purchased; balance 200
cases.action: Complete a new valid attempt with a fresh UUID
cases.expected: Exactly +100, balance 300; old chapter reward does not repeat
cases.evidence: New UUID and receipt; visible result

cases.title: Invalid and incomplete attempts
cases.action: Test checkpoint skip, backward finish, restart, and leaving before a valid finish
cases.expected: No award for each; existing records unchanged except explicit valid outcomes
cases.evidence: Each invalid reason/attempt and unchanged ledger

cases.title: Shared day/night first reward
cases.action: Finish unique valid day and night attempts
cases.expected: 800 once and 100 once, regardless of ordering; never two 800 bonuses
cases.evidence: Two unique receipts, shared chapter state

cases.title: Existing-save preservation
cases.setup: Populate the current rebuild v1 records and settings, no career store
cases.action: Install feature, open bay, reload; later complete a fresh valid attempt
cases.expected: Old PB/settings preserved; no retroactive credits from old PB; fresh valid race may claim first bonus
cases.evidence: Before/after settings and records, explicit old fixture provenance

cases.title: Attempt IDs survive lifecycle boundaries
cases.setup: Two tabs and independent race instances
cases.action: Create/restart attempts, reload one page
cases.expected: New real attempts have distinct UUIDs; already-finished receipt IDs stay stable; no instance-counter collision
cases.evidence: IDs and lifecycle trace

cases.title: Insufficient funds
cases.action: Try buying base kit
cases.expected: No negative balance, no ownership/equipped mutation; clear message
cases.evidence: Record before/after and normal UI

cases.title: Atomic buy and install
cases.action: Buy & install once
cases.expected: 200 credits, owned and equipped together; one transaction; shown balance matches durable state
cases.evidence: Receipt and before/after record, visible kit

cases.title: Repeated purchase
cases.action: Double activate pending button; retry old purchase; request new purchase ID
cases.expected: No second deduction or duplicate asset; ownership prevents a charge under a new request ID
cases.evidence: Transactions and asset/presenter count

cases.title: Fitment and catalog validation
cases.action: Submit wrong vehicle/slot, unknown product, overridden price or effect
cases.expected: Reject incompatible/unknown transactions; fixed 600-credit price and zero physics modifiers respected
cases.evidence: Negative-case store tests; no shipping phantom products

cases.title: Concurrent award and purchase
cases.method: two real browser tabs sharing IndexedDB
cases.setup: Shared fresh career then enough funds for only one kit
cases.action: Race two different first-valid receipts; race duplicate/simultaneous purchase commands
cases.expected: First completion remains single; readwrite serialization prevents lost credits/overspend; both tabs refresh from committed state
cases.evidence: Two-tab browser trace and committed records, not only mock-store tests

cases.title: Storage blocked at boot
cases.action: Play and purchase through a disclosed session-only store
cases.expected: Explicit Session only notice; coherent in-session balance/ownership; no assertion it will survive reload
cases.evidence: Error injection method, UI notice and state

cases.title: Transaction failure after boot
cases.action: Abort/fail a purchase transaction
cases.expected: No spent-but-unowned state or false durable success; safe error or explicitly disclosed session-only transition
cases.evidence: Commit failure and before/after state, recovery behavior

cases.title: Temporary unowned preview
cases.action: Preview, change color, cancel; repeat with back/scene change/race start
cases.expected: No spend/ownership change; temporary geometry/lights removed; race cannot retain unowned preview
cases.evidence: Capture and asset/light counts before/after

cases.title: Owned state and stock comparison
cases.setup: Owned kit with second color and brightness
cases.action: Equip, stock-compare, exit comparison, unequip/re-equip and reload
cases.expected: Ownership is retained, no re-charge; saved color/settings/equipment restore; stock comparison never erases them
cases.evidence: Normal menu capture plus stored state

cases.title: Ordinary earn/build/night flow
cases.setup: New career or truthfully disclosed fixture
cases.action: Valid race, reward, return, preview/cancel, buy/install, choose color, drive night, reload
cases.expected: All actual menus connected; no hidden forced equip or forged finish; 0 -> 800 -> 200 visible
cases.evidence: Progression video, companion full valid lap trace, scene transition receipts

cases.title: Lighting and mounting
cases.action: Capture matched A/B, daylight, underside mounting detail, second color and moving corner
cases.expected: Correct base kit scope; no moving-wheel/storage intersection; restrained local spill; readable pavement; normal body opacity
cases.evidence: Purposeful matched stills and separate editable Blender source/descriptor

cases.title: No physics effect
cases.setup: Identical initial state/inputs/time step, kit off/on
cases.action: Run matching trajectory including corners and brake
cases.expected: Identical physics telemetry and compatible records; no product-specific power/grip/mass modifier
cases.evidence: Input/trajectory comparison with tolerances if representation-only floats differ

cases.title: Presenter lifecycle and costs
cases.action: Equip/unequip and change scenes repeatedly
cases.expected: No cumulative object/material/light/event/audio duplication; dormant kit has bounded overhead
cases.evidence: Matched resource counts; before/after draw/triangle numbers

cases.title: Menu input and return-to-driving
cases.action: Navigate Build, confirm/cancel, adjust color, leave menu while controls held
cases.expected: Visible focus, usable confirm/back; no accidental purchase/reverse/throttle; neutral-release behavior preserved
cases.evidence: Actual ordinary input path capture; hardware access clearly labeled

cases.title: External product link
cases.action: Activate View real product deliberately
cases.expected: Only verified allowed URL; noopener/noreferrer; no auto-opening, cart writes, user IDs, live-price claim or real purchase requirement
cases.evidence: Inspect opened URL/target without submitting a real shopping transaction

cases.title: Original chapter fragment
cases.action: First entry, valid result, first equip; dismiss each; replay/reload
cases.expected: Short skippable text plays at intended safe points once; dismissal does not block reward; no paid/new voice use
cases.evidence: Flags and ordinary UI sequence

cases.title: Frozen foundation regression
cases.setup: Review07 baseline and any documented newer owner changes
cases.action: Compare protected inputs, run full suite and build
cases.expected: Accepted rear/driver/physics/route/audio preserved; no weakened tests; report exact differences and unrun cases
cases.evidence: SHA manifest, local command output, before/after tests

cases.title: Night evidence and measured budget
cases.method: ordinary-path logical capture + separate wall-clock excerpt
cases.action: Complete installed-kit night lap; capture separate 10–15 second real-time excerpt and matched kit on/off stats
cases.expected: Valid lap with honest provenance; no sustained-FPS/mobile claim from short/software capture; report stalls and rendering cost
cases.evidence: Full night trace/video; separate wall-clock timing and render statistics
